description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange w.e.f. 25.05.2020 to 31.05.2020
reasoning: This gazette notification establishes new rates of exchange for customs duties and other charges under the Customs Ordinance. It is a regulatory instrument issued by the Director General of Customs, exercising powers granted by statute. The content focuses on legal/regulatory compliance requirements for international trade and financial transactions, falling squarely under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5) rather than government personnel/structure changes or other specialized categories.
